why_essential: The algorithm must load citizen annotations to run DBSCAN and compute clusters per image.
Expert annotations are required to compute F1 and delta metrics and to average results across all expert images.
Parallelization speeds up the grid search across the large hyperparameter space and was used to run DBSCAN combinations concurrently.
Pareto-optimization functionality is used to identify Pareto-optimal hyperparameter combinations balancing F1 and delta.
The script implements the DBSCAN grid search with the custom distance metric, per-image evaluation, averaging rules, filtering by F1>0.5, and writing the Pareto frontier CSV.
